# Replay fixtures

Synthetic transcripts in each harness's own format, built from the failure categories measured
on real coordinator transcripts: a reply whose screen copy lost its Markdown, gained hard line
wraps and drew its table in boxes (`screen-reply.txt` is that rendering); a reply written in
the middle of a turn, before a tool call, which the screen collapses; reply markers quoted in a
code fence, in tool output and in a sub-agent's text, none of which is a reply. No line comes
from a real session.
